Both official lists print yíhuàng, the tone-sandhi spelling of citation yīhuàng (2025 no. 10222; GF 0025-2021 L7-4885), while CC-CEDICT has only yī huǎng for both senses ('time passing in an instant', 'a sight flashing past'). The official reading is kept because the official lists outrank CC-CEDICT; 现汉7 and the 审音表 could not be consulted in this session (web-search budget exhausted), so a later check against them is advisable. Verifier (2026-11-02): the 现汉 full text (CNMan/XDHYCD7th, y- section in 5th-edition wording) has two entries, 一晃 yīhuǎng 'to flash past' and 一晃 yīhuàng 'time passes quickly without one noticing', so yīhuàng is also the 现汉 reading of the time sense; the verifier's own text extraction of the 2025 PDF (p. 335) shows yíhuàng. Verified independently.

The official 2025 list prints rénxìng (no. 8815), which appears to be a typo in the list itself: it reads 任 as rèn in all 23 of its other 任 words (任何 rènhé, 任意 rènyì, 任 rèn, 责任 zérèn...). CC-CEDICT gives 任性 rèn xìng and uses rén only in names (the surname, place names), and HSK 2.0 also has rèn xìng, so the learner should learn rènxìng. Verifier (2026-11-02): 现汉 (CNMan/XDHYCD7th full text) reads 任性 rènxìng and gives 任 rén only for the place names 任县/任丘 and the surname; the verifier's own text extraction of the 2025 PDF (p. 300) confirms that the list prints rénxìng, so the typo diagnosis stands. Verified independently.

GF 0025-2021 prints chū∥xiě (L7-0552) and chooses the reading of 血 word by word (献血 xiànxiě, but 输血 shū∥xuè, 流血 liúxuè, 止血 zhǐxuè), which suggests xiě is deliberate rather than a typo; CC-CEDICT has chū xuè but records xiě as the colloquial reading of 血. The official-standard reading is kept; 现汉7 and the 审音表 could not be consulted in this session (web-search budget exhausted), so a later check against them is advisable. Verifier (2026-11-02): the printed 2021 standard (应用解读本 p. 82) has chū∥xiě and says its pinyin was checked against 现汉 7th ed. and 现代汉语规范词典 3rd ed.; 现汉 (CNMan/XDHYCD7th full text) has one 出血 headword, chūxiě, marked 〈方〉 'to pay out money or things for someone', while its medical compounds read xuè (大出血 dàchūxuè, 脑出血 nǎochūxuè, and 埃博拉出血热 āibólāchūxuèrè in the 7th-edition a- section), so learners will also meet chūxuè (CC-CEDICT) in medical terms; the 审音表 was still not consulted. Verified independently.

CC-CEDICT spells 嗯 only as en1/en4/en5 (although it writes syllabic nasals for 呣 m and 哼 hng) and HSK 2.0 has en, so the official citation form ǹg is kept. Verifier (2026-11-02): 现汉 (CNMan/XDHYCD7th full text) has three interjection entries, 嗯 ńg 'questioning', ňg 'surprise' and a 4th-tone ǹg 'answering yes' (the letter ǹ appears as a ▲ placeholder in the transcription), and Wiktionary also lists the falling-tone syllabic nasal; this matches the 2025 list's 嗯 ǹg 叹 (PDF p. 118). Verified independently.

Verified independently.
